query:
insert into RequirementCollectConfigs (
                latest_collection,
                product_id,
                cfg_entry,
                path,
                source_hash,
                origin_hash,
                pattern
            )
            values (
                $1,
                $2,
                $3,
                $4,
                $5,
                $6,
                $7
            )
            on conflict (
                product_id,
                cfg_entry
            ) do update
            set
                latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                path = excluded.path,
                source_hash = excluded.source_hash,
                origin_hash = excluded.origin_hash,
                pattern = excluded.pattern
